_about: Fates screen markers for the headless robot (tools/harness/markers.py, docs/ROBOT.md). Memory reads only: no picture,
no game text. A marker run dumps the guest ranges below at every shot frame (boot.exe ZAKURO_DUMP_MEM +
ZAKURO_DUMP_MEM_AT), walks the game's process tree and names each process by the class of the functions its
vtable points at (config/functions.csv names, from the game's symbol map). The dumps are deleted after the walk;
run.json keeps only the class names.
Layout, read from the code (asm/text): ProcInst::ProcInst 0x0010A2A8 zeroes +4..+28 and +40..+43;
ProcInst::FindNext 0x0011D318 walks +20 first child, +28 next sibling, +16 parent, skips +40 bit 0 (dying);
Proc::KillByName 0x0010FD20 hashes a name (h = h*31 + c, 0 -> 1) against +44 over the three root lists at
descends from it by +20 / +28 taking the last child whose +41 byte is set.

checkpoints._about: route -> shot frame -> what the walk must find (markers.check). 'current' is MainSequence::GetCurrent's process; 'classes' must be live. Seen 2026-11-11 in runs title-markers and ng-markers (from --save new-game-empty). Birthright routes (bt-*) added 2026-11-11 (stage B); 'state' entries are markers.game_state facts (exact value, or min:N).
